title: JEPA one-step action-set latent predictions
description: Deterministic point predictions from one encoded source embedding for a frozen candidate action set. This is not an uncertainty distribution or a calibrated joint draw bank.

candidate_set_sha256.description: SHA-256 over sorted action_id/action_index pairs and the action-manifest digest.

x-rust-invariants: action indices must be unique and within the configured discrete action space
source embedding is encoded exactly once and reused for every action in the returned set
candidate_set_sha256 is invariant to input row order
predicted_latent entries are deterministic point predictions; never reinterpret them as posterior samples or calibrated intervals
